text:
sam: Heads-up I opened PR #5289 to add a migration example. docs-preview failed: md-lint (line-length), linkcheck (broken anchor -> /tutorials/#batching-quickstart), and Vale flagged 'edge-case' (Writing/WeaselWords). CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/8401

docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR 5289 — checks: md-lint (1), linkcheck (1), vale (1). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/8401/logs

elyse: I can trim the long line in examples.md. Keep code blocks untouched. Wrap prose at 88 cols.

ravi: For the anchor, the header changed to "Batching quick start" -> id `#batching-quick-start`. Update link to `#batching-quick-start`.

tom: Vale's WeaselWords flags hyphenated forms sometimes. Suggest rewording "edge case" -> "rare case" or be specific.

sam: I'll push 3 tiny commits: (1) wrap prose in examples, (2) update anchor to '#batching-quick-start', (3) change 'edge-case' -> 'rare case'. Running local checks.

docs-bot: queued docs-preview for PR 5289 — build 8401 started

hana: FYI if Vale still flags, we can add a short inline comment `# nolint: WeaselWords` with a note, but prefer rewording first.

sam: local `make docs-md-lint` and `make docs-linkcheck` pass. Pushed. Commit message: "Fix: wrap examples, update batching anchor, rephrase 'edge-case'"

docs-bot: docs-preview success for PR 5289 — all checks passed

elyse: approved. Small wording nit removed in a follow-up commit.

ravi: merged at 14:12 PT during docs merge window. Thanks everyone!
